parsed.rationale: Both `StringCache` and `IntCache` in package `Caching` share four identical fields (`capacity:Int`, `hitCount:UInt64`, `lastAccess:Date?`) and differ only in the key type of `storage` — `[String: CacheEntry]` vs `[Int: CacheEntry]`. This is the canonical motivation for generic parameterization: a single `Cache<Key: Hashable>` struct with `storage: [Key: CacheEntry]` replaces both type-alias objects without any loss of expressiveness. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no intentional-duplication rule applies. The `_Plant_` filename prefix suggests these are pipeline-generated placeholders, making consolidation into a single generic type the correct production outcome.
